analysis.headline: USD/KRW settles near 1,337 on post-FOMC Treasury yield ease and month-end selling
analysis.summary: USD/KRW trades near 1,337 (ECB ref 1,337.29) as U.S. 10-year Treasury yields eased to 4.98% following the Federal Reserve's rate hold at 3.75%–4.00%. Heavy month-end dollar selling from semiconductor exporters and steady current account inflows helped curb dollar momentum, keeping the pair balanced within a 1,335–1,340 KRW trading band.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW eases to 1,488 following ECB deposit rate hold at 2.50%
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW consolidates near 1,488 (ECB ref 1,488.40) after the European Central Bank kept its deposit facility rate unchanged at 2.50% on October 29. Subdued Eurozone manufacturing momentum and ongoing French fiscal concerns capped euro gains, while softer USD/KRW rates guided the cross into a stable 1,483–1,493 KRW consolidation range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW holds near 846 KRW per 100 JPY as BOJ maintains 1.25% rate
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW trades near 8.46 KRW per 1 JPY (~846.1 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.461). The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1.25% to review inflation progress, leaving USD/JPY hovering in the upper 157s. Persistent verbal intervention alerts from Tokyo and won month-end resilience limited further yen decline, defending support at 843–850 KRW.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW hovers near 1,780 amid BoE rate-cut bets and budget watch
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW trades steadily near 1,780 (ECB ref 1,780.85) as expectations for additional Bank of England rate cuts and fiscal prudence ahead of the UK Autumn Budget restrain sterling upside. Broader U.S. dollar softening and resilient Korean export flows helped stabilize the cross within a balanced 1,775–1,785 KRW band.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW fluctuates near 200.7 on PBOC liquidity support and stimulus hopes
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW fluctuates around 200.7 (ECB ref 200.74) within a steady 200–202 band. The People's Bank of China maintained accommodative liquidity provisions and stable daily midpoint fixings to support domestic demand. Continued anticipation of fiscal stimulus execution provides solid underlying support against external currency swings.

KRW.headline: Won firms to 1,337 KRW on post-FOMC yield ease and month-end exporter selling
KRW.brief: The Korean won gained ground toward 1,337 against the dollar as easing U.S. yields and month-end semiconductor export settlements converged, backed by the BOK 3.00% rate and trade surplus.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar settles near 1,337 KRW as yields cool following FOMC hold
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar paused near 1,337 KRW as 10-year Treasury yields eased to 4.98% following the Fed rate hold, meeting active month-end selling from domestic semiconductor exporters.

EUR.headline: Euro eases to 1,488 KRW as ECB confirms 2.50% deposit rate hold
EUR.brief: The euro consolidates near 1,488 KRW after the ECB maintained its deposit rate at 2.50%, with manufacturing sluggishness capping upside as broader dollar cooling keeps trading orderly.

JPY.headline: Yen defends 846 KRW per 100 JPY on BOJ 1.25% hold and intervention watch
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen steadies near 846 KRW per 100 JPY as the BOJ held rates at 1.25% to assess inflation progress, with intervention warnings and won stability keeping down-side well protected.

CNY.headline: Yuan consolidates near 200.7 KRW amid PBOC easing and fiscal stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan trades steadily near 200.7 KRW as the PBOC continues accommodative liquidity injections and stable fixings while markets monitor the rollout of government stimulus measures.

GBP.headline: Pound tests 1,780 KRW amid BoE easing bets and Autumn Budget caution
GBP.brief: Sterling trades near 1,780 KRW as expectations for further BoE rate reductions and fiscal caution ahead of the Autumn Budget cap gains, balanced by general dollar softness and export flows.

AUD.headline: Aussie dollar supported near 940 KRW by steady RBA stance and commodity rebound
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar finds firm support near 940 KRW as the RBA maintains a cautious rate hold, bolstered by China stimulus expectations and a rebound in iron ore and bulk commodity prices.

CAD.headline: Loonie holds 955 KRW as crude rebound offsets BoC yield differential
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar defends the 955 KRW mark as resilient crude oil prices amid Middle East tensions offset widening yield differentials stemming from the Bank of Canada's easing cycle.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc holds 1,614 KRW on steady safe-haven bids despite low SNB rates
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc maintains resilient demand near 1,614 KRW as geopolitical unrest and European fiscal caution sustain safe-haven flows, countering the Swiss National Bank's low policy rate.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar steady near 170.4 KRW within currency peg band
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar trades calmly near 170.4 KRW within its 7.75–7.85 peg band against the greenback, closely tracking post-FOMC rate expectations and Asian cross-border equity flows.
